title: Homily II on the Holy Pascha
edition: PG 93; Homilia ii in sanctum pascha (Khazarzar)
author: Hesychius of Jerusalem
blurb: Hesychius of Jerusalem’s second homily on the holy Pascha, on the empty tomb and the risen Christ, in a fresh English translation from the Greek.
first_english_note: A fresh English translation of Hesychius of Jerusalem’s second homily on the holy Pascha, made from the Greek text printed in PG 93. No modern English version was used for its wording.

text_history.method: A fresh English translation made from the Greek text printed in PG 93.
